newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index slightly up in mixed market.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index slightly up in mixed market.

text.p: Market index Semdex at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius edged up by 0.56 points to 368.32 on Friday, reflecting price rises of leading stocks, dealers said.
Transactions totalled 20.09 million rupees on 759,770 shares from 25.14 million rupees on 882,451 shares on Wednesday.

Dealers said rising Mauritius Commercial Bank and conglomerate Rogers pushed up the Semdex. Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) was 50 cents higher to 85.50 rupees on 64,484 shares and Rogers rose one rupee to 97.50 on 1,653 shares.

"MCB and Rogers are among the heavyweights in the Semdex and their price rises were enough to cancel the effect of falling prices of these other ....stocks today (Friday)," one dealer said, referring to Air Mauritius and investment-based Fincorp.
Air Mauritius was down 20 cents to 44 rupees on 3,785 shares and Fincorp lost one rupee to 80 on 1,913 shares.
The rest of the market moved within tight ranges, reflecting a lack of a general trend in a market which is on the outlook for fresh news, brokers said.

Happy World Foods shed 30 cents to 16.60 rupees on 1,000 shares, State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 11.10 rupees on 381,728 shares and building materials manufacturer United Basalt Products remained at 34.70 rupees on 5,150 shares.

Consolidated Investment Trust shed 10 cents to 10.10 rupees on 10,000 shares and National Investment Trust was 20 cents lower to 13 rupees on 4,380 shares. Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert climbed 1.10 rupees to 42 on 104,789 shares.
Hotel concerns Sun Resorts gained 20 cents to 41.10 rupees on 21,505 shares and New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 33.10 rupees on 93,305 shares.
